audit.why: Level chart and phase text agree: Draven owns levels 1-5, EVEN/Skill through level 6 and first item, Tristana flips at 2+ items. Matches the kit (axe autos + Blood Rush early, Rocket Jump + Explosive Charge burst late).
Spikes correctly key level 6 (Whirling Death), first item (League of Draven gold spike), and late (Rocket Jump + Explosive Charge burst) to real kit power.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two missingInteractions were unaddressed: Whirling Death's execute threshold was described only as 'punishes low targets' with no HP-tracking cue, and Spinning Axe's auto-attack-reset combo tell (the wind-up, not the cast, is the signal to disengage) was never stated.
audit.why: Draven's R (100/90/80s CD) deals less damage per unit hit and is commonly played as a low-HP execute; the brief's missingInteractions explicitly flags both the execute-threshold and autoreset-burst-tell rules as applicable but absent from the page text.
audit.corrected: Added the execute-tracking cue to spikes[1].text and the auto-reset wind-up tell to dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Four stacks detonate the bomb: plant E, land two autos, then decide — step back at three or commit at four. Never linger between.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Whirling Death also displaces and buys fights below its execute threshold — banking it purely for the kill throws away peel and burst.

edits.before: - Draven Spinning Axe: matchup-defining — Two spinning axes is lane-bully damage — stand on his pickup spots and his power halves. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Draven Spinning Axe (Q) is 12/11/10/9/8s — matchup-defining: stand on his pickup spots while it's down and his power halves. Count it out loud. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R (100/90/80s) has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Two spinning axes is lane-bully damage — stand on his pickup spots and his power halves. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: His combo opens with the axe-catch reset — read the wind-up, not the cast, and back off. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: Draven stays ahead at 6 because his lane damage is highest and Whirling Death punishes low targets, while your jump into him just eats a Stand Aside stun and axe autos. Only all-in if his axes drop and your support hard-commits CC.
edits.after: Draven stays ahead at 6 because his lane damage is highest and Whirling Death threatens an execute at low HP, while your jump into him just eats Stand Aside and axe autos. Only all-in if his axes drop and your support hard-commits CC.

notes: spikes[1].text previously called Stand Aside (E) a 'stun' — the kit flags it as knockup/slow, not a stun; corrected to just name the ability.
